title: Spreaders (L-shaped/Bent Rod or Disposable)

references.label: General microbiology laboratory manuals (ASM curriculum resources)

purpose: A tool used to evenly distribute a liquid sample across the surface of an agar plate in the spread plate method.
safety: Sterilize a reusable glass/metal spreader (e.g. dip in ethanol and flame, letting the flame extinguish) and cool before touching the plate.
Disposable spreaders avoid the flaming step and its associated aerosol/fire risk.
